evidence: det_operator_attested.py defines 10 marker families including `("drill", r"\boperator[ -]?drill\b|\bgame[ -]?day\b|\bfire[ -]?drill\b")` and the `attested` family `r"\battested\s+by\s+recorded\b|..."` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py:103-115)

The _FIXTURES firing rows only exercise deploy, prod, live_run, iac, cloud, merge_gate, human, store_op (tests/unit/test_det_floor_operator_attested.py:38-64); the two known_case tests exercise store_op/live_run only

advisory.finding: Two of the ten operational-evidence marker families introduced by this lint — `drill` (operator-drill / game-day / fire-drill) and `attested` (attested by recorded / recorded vote outcome / etc.) — have no firing fixture and are not exercised by any test, so a regression in either family's regex would not be caught.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add two rows to _FIXTURES, e.g. ("drill", "- [ ] the operator-drill is run and recorded", True) and ("attested", "- [ ] the change id is attested by recorded vote outcome", True).
